reasoning: The July 2019 meeting marks the first rate cut since 2008, transitioning from a holding/tightening regime to an easing regime. The fed funds target range was lowered from 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent to 2 to 2-1/4 percent, and the balance sheet runoff (QT) was terminated two months early — both representing simultaneous tool-level regime changes. The prior document removed 'patient' language and signaled openness to cuts; this document executes the actual pivot.
key_quote: In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 2 to 2-1/4 percent.
